Res.Caption: To Postcode
Res.FullDescription: The Post Code of this Trade Lane's Cartage Delivery Address.

Res.Caption: From Postcode
Res.FullDescription: The Post Code of this Trade Lane's Cartage Pick-up Address.

Res.Caption: Destination
Res.FullDescription: The Country/Region, Port, International Zone or IATA City Code (Air Standard Costs only) of Destination for this Trade Lane.

Res.Caption: Category
Res.FullDescription: The general Category applied to this Rate Entry.

Res.Caption: Creation Source
Res.FullDescription: The creation source of this rate.

Res.Caption: Container Unit Section
Res.FullDescription: Ref-container Unit Section

Res.Caption: Container Material Code
Res.FullDescription: Ref-container Material Code

Res.Caption: Container Component Code
Res.FullDescription: Ref-container Component Code

Res.Caption: Container Repair Code
Res.FullDescription: Ref-container Repair Code

Res.Caption: Frequency
Res.FullDescription: The frequency of this Trade Lane's schedule.

Res.Caption: Is Cross-Trade
Res.FullDescription: This indicates whether this Trade Lane is a cross trade i.e. it is handled by an agent that is not in either the Origin or Destination countries/regions.

Res.Caption: Is Container Class Match
Res.FullDescription: If checked, this Rate Entry will apply to the container 'Freight/Handling Rate Class', specified on the selected container.

Res.Caption: Transport Mode
Res.FullDescription: The Transportation Mode this Rate Entry applies to.

Res.Caption: Recommended Agent Override
Res.FullDescription: If specified, this agent will appear on the Published Agents page in place of the default Published agent for the foreign port on this Trade Lane.

Res.Caption: Carrier Organization
Res.FullDescription: The Transport Provider Organization for the Trade Lane, often the Airline or Shipping Line Carrier Organization.

Res.Caption: Carrier Code
Res.FullDescription: The two digit carrier code of the airline if the Carrier/Transport Provider is flagged as an airline.

Res.Caption: Origin
Res.FullDescription: The Country/Region, Port, International Zone or IATA City Code (Air Standard Costs only) of Origin for this Trade Lane.

Res.Caption: Carrier Service Level
Res.FullDescription: The Service Level provided by the Carrier of this Trade Lane. This is separate to the Job Service Level.

Res.Caption: Quotation Incoterm
Res.FullDescription: The Payment Term (Incoterm) that the charges on this quotation apply to. This will be included in the heading on the quotation document.

Res.Caption: Container/Equipment Type
Res.FullDescription: The Container/Vehicle/Equipment Type this Rate Entry applies to.

Res.Caption: Via
Res.FullDescription: A Port location that is neither the Origin or Destination Port.

Res.Caption: Service Level
Res.FullDescription: The Service Level of the Job for this Trade Lane.

Res.Caption: Currency
Res.FullDescription: The default Currency used by all rates on this Rate Entry.

Res.Caption: Transit Time
Res.FullDescription: Closest value to preferable transit time or calculated days from start/end dates or ETD/ETA on Job.

Res.Caption: Is All Warehouse
Res.FullDescription: Is this Rate Entry applicable to all Warehouses.

Res.Caption: Default Units
Res.FullDescription: The default Unit used by all Rate Lines for this category of Rate Entry, e.g. defaulting the "Container" unit for FCL Freight.

Res.Caption: Publisher
Res.FullDescription: The Code of the Company that Published this Global Rate Entry.

Res.Caption: Is Published
Res.FullDescription: If selected, this Rate Entry will become Globally Published and can be used when AutoRating Jobs in any Company.

Res.Caption: Is TACT Rate
Res.FullDescription: This Rate Entry was generated from an imported IATA TACT Rate file.

Res.Caption: Exclude from Autocosting
Res.FullDescription: Is this Rate Entry excluded from Autocosting.

Res.Caption: First Route Set Load Port
Res.FullDescription: The first Load Port of the first Route Set.

Res.Caption: Last Route Set Discharge Port
Res.FullDescription: The last Discharge Port of the last Route Set.
